what: The rarity of a Genesis changes how its special attack is delivered: an Uncommon Genesis fires it twice (echo). The hero card gets a fourth line for the rarity.
method: Headless Chrome, muted, touch emulation, through the LAN address on staging port 8084, page options token=408&charged=1&perf=1, 40 s of match after the scripted special; then the build was moved to port 8083.
import: Roster import summary of the build: '1969 heroes, 3 of 3 roles with a character, 100 signatures authored for 50 pairs of shape and effect, ruleset genesis-0.3.0'.

combat_log.pairs: Every echo skill logged its actions in pairs: gaps of 0.53, 0.55, 1.00, 0.54 and 0.86 s between the two actions of one cast (the browser renders about five frames a second, which stretches some gaps). The direct skills logged one action per cast.
combat_log.damage: 7 damage events of 1200, which is 60% of the 2000 of a raw nova. No 1560 event: the echo flash of the player's hero touched nobody in this run.
combat_log.console: No error. Three warnings unrelated to the game (webcam, file system sync, Content-Length).

hero_card.seen: Card of CHOG #1869 (token 408): 'OUTFIT : Orange Sleeveless / BRUTE', 'EYES : Modern VR / FLASH', 'AURA : none / RAW', 'RARITY : Uncommon / ECHO fires twice, half a second apart, 60% each'. Four lines fit the card.

tests: 20 Quantum tests pass. 'a Genesis fires the signature of its Eyes and Aura...' now also checks that an Uncommon Genesis gets another special than a Common one with the same Eyes and Aura, and that a delivery without assets falls back to the direct signature. The card test expects the Rarity line.
limits: Three deliveries are not built: return (60 Genesis), persistent-zone (30) and inversion (10) play like a direct hit, and their card says 'not built yet, plays like a direct hit'.
The 60% share is a first number, not balanced: two hits at 60% are 120% of a direct hit if both land.
That exactly two actions fire per cast is read from the skill timing code and from the paired log lines of this run; there is no simulation test that steps a skill through its lifetime.
No Uncommon Genesis has the puddle shape (echo by shape in the roster: wave 296, nova 137, flash 89, beam 68, puddle 0), so the ten echo puddle assets are authored and used by nobody.
